The user's mention of "γ=0.95" and "γ=1.0" clearly refers to the main gamma parameter. input.command:
cat > /root/autodl-tmp/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN/launch_gsweep.sh << 'SHEOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: bash launch_gsweep.sh <variant> [gpu_ids]
# Example: bash launch_gsweep.sh g095 "2,3"
#          bash launch_gsweep.sh g100 "0,1"
# Default GPU: 2,3

set -euo pipefail

VARIANT="${1:?Usage: bash launch_gsweep.sh g095|g100 [gpu_ids]}"
GPU_IDS="${2:-2,3}"

case "$VARIANT" in
  g095)
    CONFIG="_alfworld_gamma_sweep_g095_h5"
    EXPNAME="gsweep-g095-h5-seed1"
    ;;
  g100)
    CONFIG="_alfworld_gamma_sweep_g100_h5"
    EXPNAME="gsweep-g100-h5-seed1"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Unknown variant: $VARIANT (use g095 or g100)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_IDS"

cd /root/autodl-tmp/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN

echo "=== Launching $VARIANT ==="
echo "Config: $CONFIG"
echo "Experiment: $EXPNAME"
echo "GPUs: $GPU_IDS"
echo ""

python train.py \
  --config-name "$CONFIG" \
  seed.train=10000 \
  trainer.experiment_name="$EXPNAME" \
  system.CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_IDS"
